name: Saint-Pardon Tidal Bore (Mascaret, Dordogne), France
text: Derived from the 2026 mascaret calendar of La Péniche du Mascaret. Its times apply about 2 km downstream of the Péniche (0.3744° W); for the Impasse du Mascaret at Saint-Pardon, 4.3 km further upstream along the river, we add 14 minutes at the calendar's mean wave speed of 18 km/h. The size follows the French tidal coefficient (small below 80, moderate below 95, large from 95). The mascaret only forms on larger tides.

pruefung.hinweis: Pruefwerte aus getrennter Eichung; Modell danach ueber den ganzen Kalender geeicht

quelle: Calendrier du mascaret 2026, La Péniche du Mascaret (Saint-Pardon); Klasse aus dem Koeffizienten (<80, <95, >=95)
